item.title: 🔵 Mandiant details how ShinyHunters abuse SSO to steal cloud data
item.description:

item.title: 🔵 Microsoft Flags Multi-Stage AitM Phishing and BEC Attacks Targeting Energy Firms
item.description:
Why this matters: Increased credential/phishing risk for users; reinforce MFA and user awareness.
Microsoft has warned of a multi‑stage adversary‑in‑the‑middle (AitM) phishing and business email compromise (BEC) campaign targeting multiple organizations in the energy sector. "The campaign abused SharePoint file‑sharing services to deliver phishing payloads and relied on inbox rule creation to maintain persistence and evade user awareness," the Microsoft Defender Security Research Team said.

Source: The Hacker News   Severity: FYI

item.title: 🔵 SMS Phishers Pivot to Points, Taxes, Fake Retailers
item.description:
Why this matters: Increased credential/phishing risk for users; reinforce MFA and user awareness.
China-based phishing groups blamed for non-stop scam SMS messages about a supposed wayward package or unpaid toll fee are promoting a new offering, just in time for the holiday shopping season: Phishing kits for mass-creating fake but convincing e-commerce websites that convert customer payment card data into mobile wallets from Apple and Google. Experts say these same phishing groups also are now using SMS lures that promise unclaimed tax refunds and mobile rewards points.

Source: Krebs on Security   Severity: FYI
